Vendored libraries, served from this site (no CDN). Each is pinned by SHA256SUMS; the Privacy check workflow fails if any file changes or an unpinned file is added.

- html2canvas 1.4.1 (MIT), https://html2canvas.hertzen.com, used for "Export image" on the header page.
- jsQR 1.4.0 (Apache-2.0), https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR, decodes QR codes in email images on the triage page.
- spark-md5 3.0.2 (WTFPL or MIT), https://github.com/satazor/js-spark-md5, MD5 hashes of attachments (browsers only provide SHA hashes).
